D 为峰值频偏；M 为最高调制频率（FM 话音）或键控速率（FSK）。FSK 的: D is the peak deviation; M is the highest modulating frequency (FM voice) or the keying rate (FSK). For FSK the question bank plugs the shift straight in as D (RTTY's 170 Hz is the spacing between the two tones; the engineering peak deviation is only half of it, 85 Hz). By the bank's convention: RTTY with 170 Hz shift and 50 Bd → 2×(170+50) = 440 Hz, and the exam takes it as no more than 450 Hz

Gi、Gd 为功率倍数，dBi = dBd + 2.15，所以 EIRP 比 E: Gi and Gd are power ratios, and dBi = dBd + 2.15, so EIRP is 2.15 dB above ERP. Example: 10 W with 3.85 dBd = 6 dBi (×4) → EIRP 40 W; 10 W with 5.15 dBi = 3 dBd (×2) → ERP 20 W
I = Pout / (η · U)，W = Pout · t / η: I = Pout / (η · U), W = Pout · t / η
Pout 为射频输出功率，η 为电源效率；例：η = 80%、13.8 V 时: Pout is the RF output power and η the supply efficiency. Example: at η = 80% and 13.8 V, I ≈ 0.091 × Pout (A); at 220 V, ≈ 0.0057 × Pout; transmitting for 10 s uses ≈ 3.5×10⁻⁶ × Pout (kWh)
Rs 为符号速率（波特），M 为每个符号的状态数；例：MFSK16 为 15.6: Rs is the symbol rate (baud) and M the number of states per symbol. Example: MFSK16 is 15.625 Bd × log₂16 = 62.5 bit/s; RTTY has only 2 states, so baud and bit/s are numerically equal
S 表每格 6 dB：功率变为 1/4（电压减半）少 1 格；距离加倍路径损耗多: Each S-meter step is 6 dB: a quarter of the power (half the voltage) is one step lower; doubling the distance adds 6 dB of path loss, also about one step. Example: 100 W → 25 W is one step lower
Vp 为交流分量的峰值；含直流分量时 Vrms² = Vdc² + Vac²（V: Vp is the peak of the AC component; with a DC component, Vrms² = Vdc² + Vac² (Vac is the RMS of the AC component). Example: a 0 to 100 V square wave has a true RMS of 70.7 V and a triangle wave 57.7 V; one question-bank item on a 0 to 100 V square wave counts only the AC amplitude and answers 50 V
d 为距离（km），f 为频率（MHz），L 为损耗（dB）；距离或频率每增大: d is the distance (km), f the frequency (MHz) and L the loss (dB); every tenfold increase in distance or frequency adds 20 dB, and doubling adds about 6 dB (the exact constant is 32.45)
dBi 相对各向同性，dBd 相对半波偶极: dBi is relative to an isotropic radiator, dBd to a half-wave dipole

取一个周期的平均，即直流分量；适用于正弦、三角波和占空比 50% 的方波，对称于: Average over one period, i.e. the DC component; valid for sine, triangle and 50% duty square waves. It is 0 for waveforms symmetric about 0 and half the peak-to-peak value when the minimum is 0; a full-wave rectified sine averages 0.637 × Vp
各级增益 dB 直接相加: Stage gains in dB simply add

并联电阻取倒数之和的倒数: Parallel resistance is the reciprocal of the sum of reciprocals

本振高于信号时镜频 = 信号 + 2×中频，低于时 = 信号 − 2×中频；例：: With the local oscillator above the signal, image = signal + 2 × IF; below it, image = signal − 2 × IF. Example: 145.00 MHz with a 45.05 MHz IF → 235.10 or 54.90 MHz
正弦有效值: RMS value of a sine wave

电压比等于匝数比，阻抗比等于匝数比的平方，电流比与匝数比相反；例：450 Ω 变: The voltage ratio equals the turns ratio, the impedance ratio equals the square of the turns ratio, and the current ratio is the inverse of the turns ratio. Example: 450 Ω to 50 Ω needs 3:1; 3 turns : 6 turns gives a 1:4 impedance transformation
行波系数 = (1−|Γ|)/(1+|Γ|)，与驻波比互为倒数: Traveling-wave ratio = (1−|Γ|)/(1+|Γ|), the reciprocal of the SWR
谐振时容抗与感抗相互抵消: At resonance the capacitive and inductive reactances cancel
通电 1 个 τ 后：RC 中电容电压升到 63%、电阻电压降到 37%；RL: After one τ: in an RC circuit the capacitor voltage rises to 63% and the resistor voltage falls to 37%; in an RL circuit the resistor voltage rises to 63% and the inductor voltage falls to 37%
频率越高容抗越小: The higher the frequency, the lower the capacitive reactance
频率越高感抗越大: The higher the frequency, the greater the inductive reactance
